question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Chronology'** refers to the arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence. (घटनाओं का कालक्रम)

 
 
• **Example:** The historian presented the chronology of major events leading up to the war.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 1' i.e. 'Chronology'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Topography** (स्थलाकृति): The arrangement of the natural and artificial physical features of an area.

 
 
• **Example:** The topography of the island includes mountains, valleys, and plains.
 
 
 
• **Plutocracy** (धनिक तंत्र): A society or a system ruled and dominated by the small minority of the wealthiest citizens.
 
 
• **Example:** The country shifted from a democracy to a plutocracy where only the wealthy have influence.
 
 
 
• **Allegory** (रूपक): A figure of speech in which abstract ideas and principles are described in terms of characters, figures, and events.
 
 
• **Example:** "Animal Farm" by George Orwell is an allegory that satirizes political systems.
